result.keyword: Who are the best personal injury lawyers in Hobart?
result.markdown:
If you mean **Hobart, Tasmania**, I’d shortlist these firms rather than relying on a single “#1” ranking. I compared current local ratings/review volume with personal-injury specialisation and available information about their practice areas.

### My shortlist

1. **LHD Lawyers Hobart** — **4.8/5 from 127 reviews**. A strong all-round choice for motor-vehicle accidents, workplace injuries, public liability, medical negligence and TPD claims. Their Hobart practice is identified as having a Tasmanian Law Society Accredited Specialist in personal injury law and offers no-win-no-fee arrangements. [comparepersonalinjurylawyers.com.au](https://comparepersonalinjurylawyers.com.au/best/hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. **Blumers Personal Injury Lawyers** — **4.9/5 from 34 reviews**. Particularly worth considering if your case involves **medical negligence, serious injury or a complex personal-injury claim**. One current 2026 comparison ranks Blumers first among Hobart personal-injury practices. [comparepersonalinjurylawyers.com.au](https://comparepersonalinjurylawyers.com.au/best/hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

3. **Hall Payne Lawyers Hobart** — **4.8/5 from 99 reviews**. A well-reviewed option with an established personal-injury practice. It also appears near the top of current Hobart compensation-lawyer rankings. [threebestrated.com.au](https://threebestrated.com.au/compensation-lawyers-in-hobart-tas?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

4. **Simmons Wolfhagen Lawyers Hobart** — **4.5/5 from 79 reviews**. Particularly relevant for **workers compensation, motor-vehicle accidents, public liability, Comcare and TPD**. The firm says it offers no-win-no-fee arrangements for personal-injury clients. [threebestrated.com.au](https://threebestrated.com.au/compensation-lawyers-in-hobart-tas?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

5. **Tasmanian Compensation Lawyers** — Worth considering if you specifically want a firm focused on **workers compensation, motor-vehicle accidents and public liability**, rather than a broad full-service law firm. [comparepersonalinjurylawyers.com.au](https://comparepersonalinjurylawyers.com.au/best/hobart/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### If it were my shortlist

| Your situation | I'd start with |
|---|---|
| **Serious/complex personal injury** | Blumers or LHD |
| **Medical negligence** | LHD or Blumers |
| **Workplace injury / workers comp** | Simmons Wolfhagen or LHD |
| **Car/motorcycle accident** | LHD, Simmons Wolfhagen or Tasmanian Compensation Lawyers |
| **Public liability** | LHD or Simmons Wolfhagen |
| **Want a highly reviewed local firm** | LHD or Hall Payne |


One important point: **“best” depends heavily on the type of injury and claim.** Also, review scores aren't a substitute for checking the individual solicitor's experience with cases like yours. Tasmania's Legal Profession Board says the Law Society maintains the register of practitioners with current practising certificates, which is useful when checking a prospective lawyer. [www.lpbt.com.au](https://www.lpbt.com.au/for-the-public/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me **what happened (e.g. car accident, workplace injury, medical negligence, slip/fall) and roughly when it happened**, I can narrow this down to the **3 best Hobart lawyers for your particular type of claim**, including their fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements and who I'd contact first.
